inspect.text: Support EnduranceLv. 0 / 10Adds 0.3 seconds per level to future Tide and Aurora buffs, from 3s to 6s. The minimum recast interval stays 13s through level 7, so downtime remains longer than active duration. Level 8 unlocks a 4.8s minimum recast: sufficient Charge Rate can sustain its 5.4s buffs. Natural charge can take longer. Ultimates keep their stronger buff. Each level takes at least 45 days even at continuous 8x with all work reductions; the first sustained milestone takes at least 360 dedicated research days after unlock. Existing casts retain their strength and expiry.Current: 3s buffs; 13s minimum recast; sustained cycling unlocks at level 8Next: 3.3s buffs; 13s minimum recast; sustained cycling unlocks at level 8.Takes 642d 20h 34m 18s · 5.00B 200.00M
